mil5.5.11:3.2: Iti kho bhikkhave Āḷāro Kālāmo ācariyo me samāno antevāsiṃ maṃ samānaṃ attanā samasamaṃ ṭhapesi uḷārāya ca maṃ pūjāya pūjesīti.
mil5.5.11:3.4: Na me ācariyo atthi, sadiso me na vijjatīti
mil5.5.11:3.5: tena hi: Iti kho bhikkhave Āḷāro Kālāmo ācariyo me samāno antevāsiṃ maṃ samānaṃ attanā samasamaṃ ṭhapesīti yaṃ vacanaṃ taṃ micchā.
mil5.5.11:3.7: Iti kho bhikkhave Āḷāro Kālāmo ācariyo me samāno antevāsiṃ maṃ samānaṃ attanā samasamaṃ ṭhapesīti, tena hi: Na me ācariyo atthi, sadiso me na
mil5.5.11:3.9: Ayam-pi ubhatokoṭiko pañho tavānuppatto, sa tayā nibbāhitabbo ti.
mil5.5.11:6.2: Iti kho bhikkhave Āḷāro Kālāmo ācariyo me samāno antevāsiṃ maṃ samānaṃ attanā samasamaṃ ṭhapesi uḷārāya ca maṃ pūjāya pūjesīti.
mil5.5.11:7.1: Tañ-ca pana vacanaṃ pubbe va sambodhā anabhisambuddhassa bodhisattass' eva sato ācariyabhāvaṃ sandhāya bhāsitaṃ.
mil5.5.11:8.1: Pañc' ime mahārāja pubbe va sambodhā anabhisambuddhassa bodhisattassa sato ācariyā, yehi anusiṭṭho Bodhisatto tattha tattha divasaṃ vītināmesi,
mil5.5.11:8.3: Ye te mahārāja aṭṭha brāhmaṇā jātamatte Bodhisatte lakkhaṇāni parigaṇhiṃsu, seyyathīdaṃ:
mil5.5.11:8.4: Rāmo, Dhajo, Lakkhaṇo, Mantī, Yañño, Suyāmo, Subhojo, Sudatto,
mil5.5.11:8.5: te tassa sotthiṃ pavedayitvā rakkhākammaṃ akaṃsu, te ca paṭhamaṃ ācariyā.
mil5.5.11:9.1: Puna ca paraṃ mahārāja: Bodhisattassa pitā Suddhodano rājā yaṃ tena samayena abhijātaṃ udiccaṃ jātivantaṃ padakaṃ veyyākaraṇaṃ chaḷangavantaṃ Sabbamittaṃ nāma brāhmaṇaṃ upanetvā sovaṇṇena bhinkārena udakaṃ oṇojetvā: imaṃ kumāraṃ sikkhāpehīti adāsi, ayaṃ dutiyo ācariyo.
mil5.5.11:10.1: Puna ca paraṃ mahārāja: Yā sā devatā Bodhisattaṃ saṃvejesi, yassā vacanaṃ sutvā Bodhisatto saṃviggo ubbiggo tasmiṃ yeva khaṇe nekkhamnikkhamitvā pabbaji, ayaṃatiyo ācariyo.
mil5.5.11:11.1: Puna ca paraṃ mahārāja: Āḷāro Kālām ayaṃ catuttho ācariyo.
mil5.5.11:12.1: Puna ca paraṃ mahārāja: Uddako Rāmaputto, ayaṃ pāmo ācariyo.
mil5.5.11:13.1: Ime kho mahārāja pubbe va sambodhā anabhisambuddhassa bodhisattassasato pañca ācariyā.
mil5.5.11:13.2: Te ca pana ācariyā lokiye dhamme.
mil5.5.11:13.3: Imasmiñ-ca pana mahārāja lokuttare dhamme sabbaññutañāṇapaṭivedhāya na-tthi Tathāgatassa anuttaro anusāsako. Sayambhū mahārāja Tathāgato anācariyako, tasmā kāraṇā Tathāgatena bhaṇitaṃ:
mil5.5.11:15.1: Sādhu bhante Nāgasena, evam-etaṃ, tathā sampaṭicchāmīti.
